body: - **IMPL.** D3 harness (`_d-harness-g1-d3/`; the round-6 `_c6-harness-g2/s01ai.mjs` differs from it only in the fake-acp path, so the D3 copy ran unchanged), repointed to this worktree and kept in `_d-harness-g1-d4/` with a 01-only chain (`chain01.mjs`: s01ai, s01b, s01c, s01d, then home2 for `cf-home-prompt`) and `final-index-d4.mjs`. No scenario needed adapting to the round-6 product: every id was reached. Fresh release client, throwaway HOME/XDG + stub claude, `NO_OPEN=1 MAUDE_NO_AUTOBUILD=1`, Playwright Chromium 1600 x 1000, light + dark. The AI frames use the fake agent (9 s steps); the finish frame is shot inside the 1.8 s `data-fresh` window with the panel folded and the result toast up; `cf-undo-ai` waits for the run's Done, then shoots while the "Undone — <label> · Redo" toast is up.

ids.cf-ai-done: IMPL = two frames: the panel-folded frame with the result toast shot while `[data-fresh]` is on, and the panel reopened ~2 s later (settled)
ids.cf-undo-ai: shot after the run ended (⌘Z is refused while your own AI works), while the undo toast "Undone — Try a dark hero · Redo" is up
ids.cf-busy: unreachable — needs other people on the canvas (presence, two AI chats, a second person): a hub / collab peers; no local route
ids.cf-ai-drafting: IMPL = drafting frame + the tablet-landed frame (the shell fits the camera while AI drafts)
